clue.text: He is taken in by a girl, who fluttered them?

definitions.text: He is taken in by a girl, who fluttered them?

indicators.note: being taken in by something means being enclosed within it, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a lass is a girl
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man is charmed by a flirtatious girl batting her eyes.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is also the definition: a girl taking in a man by fluttering her eyelashes is exactly what the wordplay pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyelashes are what a coquettish girl flutters to beguile an admirer.

clue.text: Bill received in connection with port

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
re means regarding, in connection with

explanation.surface: An invoice has arrived concerning some fortified wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like the drink but is the definition: Acre is a historic port city in northern Israel.
explanation.definitionFit: Acre is an ancient harbour city on the Mediterranean coast of Israel.

clue.text: A question of personal welfare

parts.note: the everyday greeting that asks after someone's health and state of mind

explanation.definitionFit: The stock greeting enquires about how someone is faring, their wellbeing.

clue.text: Man — a Scottish isle? Yes

parts.note: to man a post is to staff it

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether the Isle of Man is Scottish and is told yes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' looks like the Isle of Man but is the verb meaning to staff; 'Yes' simply confirms the question. Staffa is a small Hebridean island famous for Fingal's Cave.
explanation.definitionFit: Staffa is an uninhabited island of the Inner Hebrides off western Scotland.

clue.text: It is difficult being so sensitive

definitions.meaning: a tricky situation needing careful handling
easily made to laugh or squirm by light touching

explanation.surface: Being so thin-skinned is a trial.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both awkward to handle and responsive to being touched lightly.

clue.text: Fancy Kate over Letitia? It's Hobson's choice

indicators.note: as an adjective, fancy means elaborate or reworked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Would you prefer Kate to Letitia? You have no real choice.
explanation.walkthrough: Hobson's choice, named after a Cambridge stable owner who let customers take only the horse nearest the door, means no choice at all.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase offers one option or nothing, exactly the sense of an apparent choice that is none.

clue.text: Tap observed to be crooked

parts.note: a stopcock is a tap or valve
to eye something is to look at it

explanation.surface: A tap is seen to be bent out of true.
explanation.definitionFit: Cockeyed is an informal synonym for askew or out of line.

clue.text: Girl gets lad in trouble

indicators.note: trouble here means disturb, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A girl gets a young man into difficulties.
explanation.definitionFit: Linda is a girl's name, so it can stand for a girl.

clue.text: Bacterium may be found on all meals badly cooked

indicators.note: food badly cooked is spoilt and messed up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Undercooked dishes can carry food-poisoning bacteria.
explanation.definitionFit: Salmonella is a genus of bacteria that cause food poisoning.

clue.text: Flinch because of a handicap

explanation.surface: Someone recoils on account of a disability.
explanation.definitionFit: As two words it means to recoil; as one word, a disadvantage.

clue.text: Locks may be the key to their existence

definitions.text: Locks may be the key to their existence

parts.words: Locks may be the key to their existence
parts.note: not hair or door locks but the gated chambers that let boats climb hills on inland waterways

explanation.definitionFit: Artificial waterways depend on lock chambers to cope with changes in ground level.

clue.text: Provisional accommodation

parts.note: read not as temporary housing but as housing for provisions, that is, a home for food

explanation.definitionFit: A fridge is the appliance where food provisions are kept cold.

clue.text: Lacking inspiration, he goes for a walk

explanation.surface: An uninspired man takes a stroll.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means dull as an adjective and someone walking as a noun.

clue.text: Extremely inventive signalman

definitions.meaning: Edward ..., the American naval officer who invented the ... light, a signal flare

explanation.surface: A railway signalman is highly creative.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is an intensifier and also the surname of the inventor of the signal flare.

clue.text: Girl in love getting married was overcome

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, written as O
Vera is a girl's name
wed means married

explanation.surface: A girl in love was overwhelmed on marrying.
explanation.definitionFit: To be overawed is to be overcome with awe or intimidation.

clue.text: Gave up and left

explanation.surface: Someone surrendered and walked out.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both relinquished and deserted, as a car is left by its owner.

clue.text: Say I'd go after a government subsidy

indicators.note: one piece is placed following another, so the letters for I'd come after the A

parts.note: to state is to say
the contraction written without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: Someone says they will pursue a grant from the government.
explanation.definitionFit: State aid is the official name for public money given to support firms or bodies.

clue.text: Denial of victim in valid case

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other, and 'case' confirms the valid word is the container

parts.note: real means genuine, valid
a butt is the target or victim of jokes

explanation.surface: A rejection of the claim of an injured party with a sound case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case' adds to 'in': the word for valid forms the case around the victim.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebuttal is a refutation or contradiction of a claim.

clue.text: Flags and sail adjusted

indicators.note: adjusting changes the arrangement, so these four letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Banners and a sail are set right on a yacht.
explanation.definitionFit: To flag is to tire or weaken, as to ail is to be unwell or decline.

clue.text: Start breeding a bird dog

indicators.note: the start of the word breeding is its first letter

parts.note: an eagle is a bird

explanation.surface: Begin breeding a hunting dog that retrieves birds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bird dog' looks like one phrase; it splits, 'bird' going with 'a' as the eagle and 'dog' as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A beagle is a small hound bred for hunting hares.

clue.text: Far better than other door-to-door salesmen?

definitions.text: Far better than other door-to-door salesmen?

parts.words: Far better than other door-to-door salesmen?
parts.note: an idiom for being far superior, read literally as being several roads in front of rival hawkers

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means much superior, here pictured as hawkers working the roads in front.

clue.text: Queen Elizabeth — right or wrong

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, the royal cipher

explanation.surface: Was Queen Elizabeth correct or mistaken?
explanation.definitionFit: An error is something wrong, a mistake; noun for noun with a wrong.

clue.text: Type of fuel, God willing, used without hesitation

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: DV, Deo volente, Latin for God willing
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A fuel is used, God permitting, with no pausing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without hesitation' reads as 'promptly', but 'without' means outside. DERV is British diesel fuel for road vehicles.
explanation.definitionFit: Derv is the British name for diesel oil used in road vehicles.

clue.text: International codeword is rare in operation

indicators.note: letters put to work are worked over, so these are rearranged

explanation.surface: A global code name is seldom used during a mission.
explanation.definitionFit: Sierra is the word for S in the NATO phonetic alphabet.

clue.text: Contact him if the motor starts to hesitate

definitions.text: Contact him if the motor starts to hesitate

parts.words: Contact him if the motor starts to hesitate
parts.note: the mechanic to call when an engine falters, with a hint that the word is a motor followed by a hesitation

explanation.definitionFit: A mechanical specialist is whom you call when a motor is running badly.

clue.text: Enjoying surplus wealth

parts.note: describes a bank balance on the positive side, having money to spare

explanation.definitionFit: Having a positive bank balance means having more money than is owed.

clue.text: At last I have something for the salad

parts.note: the end comes at last
the contraction I've, without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: Finally there is something to add to the salad.
explanation.definitionFit: Endive is a leafy chicory used in salads.
